title: Hold a cutting board up at a pot's rim with one hand while the other scrapes the chopped vegetables off it into the pot
instruction: Hold the cutting board up by its grip bar with its end over the pot, and with the other hand scrape the chopped vegetables off the board into the pot with the bench scraper.
context: Prep cooks move chopped vegetables from the board to the pot many times a shift: one hand lifts the board to the pot's rim and the other scrapes the pieces off its end with a bench scraper. Wet pieces stick to the board, so tipping it does not shed them, and the pot's rim stands above a board lying on the counter.
setup: A table in front of two arms (bases 61 cm apart), seen by one overhead camera and a camera on each wrist. Distances are measured forward from the line between the arm bases and sideways from the midpoint between them. (1) A loose wooden cutting board, 250 g: 30 x 14 cm and 1 cm thick, lying flat with its long side left-right, its middle 31 cm forward and 6 cm left; a dark wooden grip bar 2.5 cm square runs across its left end, on top. (2) Twelve loose diced vegetables (carrot, celery, onion), 1.2 cm cubes of 2 g, on the board's right half in a patch of 3 rows of 4, from 3 cm left to 4 cm right of the centre line. (3) A fixed black pot, 17 cm across inside and 7 cm tall, centred 31 cm forward and 20 cm right; the board's right end lies 2 cm from it. (4) A loose bench scraper, 90 g: a steel blade 10 cm wide and 4 cm tall with a wooden bar 2.2 cm square along its top, standing blade down, running front to back, in a fixed dark rack 20 cm forward and 33 cm right. The layout is the same in every trial, as in the screenshot.
scoring: Judged at the end of the trial. On the board: a piece lying on the board's face. In the pot: a piece's centre inside the pot's wall and below its rim. Spilt: anywhere else (the table, the rack, outside the pot). 1.0: at least 10 of the 12 pieces in the pot and at most 1 spilt; 0.5: at least 6 in the pot and at most 2 spilt; 0.25: at least 3 in the pot; else 0.0. The trial ends at the run limit, or once the full score has held with every piece still for 1 s.
reset_notes: Lay the board back flat where it lay, put the twelve pieces back on it in their patch of 3 rows of 4, and stand the scraper back in its rack, blade down.
fidelity: Rigid-body simulation (Isaac Sim 6.1, PhysX, 20 Hz control). Simplified: the vegetables are twelve rigid 1.2 cm cubes; their wetness is a pull of three times their weight onto the board's face, applied by the task code while a piece lies on it, so they stay on a tipped board until pushed off its end. The board and scraper are rigid; the pot and the rack are fixed. Cameras 1280 x 704 (Dream-1 sees 320 x 176).
